The '''Horadric Cube''' is far more than a convenience in D2R-XL 2012: most of the ways to improve, reroll, upgrade and
destroy items go through it. The tables below list every recipe the game's cube table holds, grouped the way
[https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/cube.html Brother Laz's cube page] groups them.

== Crafting Points ==
Many recipes work only when the items you wear give you enough '''Crafting Points'''. A recipe that needs them says so
in its notes, for example "more than 500 Crafting Points" for the alchemy recipes.

== Reagents ==
* '''Oils, Catalysts, Sacrificial Heart, Meditation Candle''': bought from the matching vendor.
* '''Arcane Shards''': made by disenchanting unique and set items; five of them make an '''Arcane Crystal'''.
* '''Mystic Orbs''': bought from magic item vendors or dropped by monsters. Not every orb is for sale.
* '''Shrines''': orange crucifixes that drop late in Terror and in Destruction difficulty, used for shrine crafting and
  blessings. Each shrine has 10 charges.

== How to read the tables ==
* ''Inputs'' are the items you put in the cube. "any Weapon" means any item of that type; the words in brackets are the
  quality or state the item needs (unique, non-ethereal, no sockets ...).
* ''Output'' is what the cube gives back. "the item" is your first input with the modifiers listed under it added;
  "the item rerolled" is a new item of the same base. A modifier with a chance may or may not appear.
* ''Rows'' are the rows of <code>cubemain.txt</code> a line stands for. Recipes that exist once per base, shrine
  charge or character level are shown as one line.

== Disenchanting ==
Destroy spare unique or set items for Arcane Shards or Signets of Learning. Five Arcane Shards make an Arcane Crystal, which many other recipes need.

== Uptier recipes ==
Move a tiered item to the next tier: better base stats and more sockets, higher requirements. These recipes do not make sacred items.
{| class="wikitable cube-recipes"
! Recipe !! Inputs !! Output !! Notes !! Rows
{{Cube recipe
|section=Uptier recipes
|recipe=Unique uptier recipe
|inputs=one of 1100 (e.g. Aerin Shield (1) (unique), Ancient Armor (1) (unique), Angel Star (1) (unique))
Arcane Crystal
any Rune
|output=one of 1100 (e.g. Aerin Shield (2) (unique), Ancient Armor (2) (unique), Angel Star (2) (unique))
|notes=item level 100; 1100 variants, 1100 rows
|rows=8421-9520
}}
{{Cube recipe
|section=Uptier recipes
|recipe=Any uptier recipe
|inputs=one of 1100 (e.g. Aerin Shield (1) (non-ethereal), Ancient Armor (1) (non-ethereal), Angel Star (1) (non-ethereal))
Arcane Crystal
|output=one of 1100 (e.g. Aerin Shield (2) (keeps its modifiers), Ancient Armor (2) (keeps its modifiers), Angel Star (2) (keeps its modifiers))
|notes=1100 variants, 1100 rows
|rows=9521-10620
}}
|}
== Mystic Orbs ==
